description: Multi-instance read-only MCP server for ServiceNow
name: io.github.ImJaineel/SN-MCP-Server

environmentVariables.description: Path to `sn-instance.json` file that contains ServiceNow instance credentials
environmentVariables.name: SN_INSTANCE_CONFIG

environmentVariables.description: Optional: Enable verbose logging for debugging
environmentVariables.name: SN_MCP_SERVER_VERBOSE

environmentVariables.description: Optional: Preferred log directory (defaults to current working directory)
environmentVariables.name: SN_LOG_DIR

environmentVariables.description: Optional: GitHub Personal Access Token for `sn_read_docs` (branch lookup and GitHub search)
environmentVariables.name: GITHUB_TOKEN
